Colormaker Industries Australia is a well-established, family-owned manufacturer of quality coatings for interior and exterior application. Amongst a broad range of technologies, Colormaker also manufactures and exports market leading world class products in textile screen printing inks and high solids epoxy swimming pool coatings. The business is based on Sydney’s Northern Beaches.

We require a dedicated coatings & inks Quality Control (QC) Chemist to join our busy team of specialists in Brookvale, NSW.

Reporting to the Senior Chemist and Technical Manager, the duties and responsibilities of the role will include:

. Performing laboratory tests/QC procedures on paints and raw materials and recommending improvements for Factory Production and Product Development
. Preparing materials for test and/or experimentation
. Performing calculations, computations and measurements
. Analyzing test data results and preparing relevant reviews, reports and summaries
. Auditing and controlling the quality and quantity of materials used in QC tests, R&D and product maintenance
. Checking, calibrating and maintaining test equipment and other laboratory facilities
. Management of Safety Data Sheets, both Raw Materials and Finished Goods
. Technical and other support to Customer Service and Marketing, including translation of technical and other product literature
. Proficient use of Tencia/Arrow, Color I Control and relevant business software (including MS EXCEL). Also use of company systems
. Maintenance of relevant QC and Production records and related administration
. Adhering to appropriate workplace health and safety standards and making recommendations for improvement
. Management of Hazardous Materials and Dangerous Goods.
. Advising and sourcing materials for Research and Development (R&D) projects
. Carrying out product development work on new and existing products

We offer a competitive remuneration package of between $70,000 to $85,000 per annum, excluding superannuation.

The successful candidate will have either:

. A relevant AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma plus five (5) years’ work experience; or
. At least ten (10) years of relevant full-time work experience

The successful candidate must have coatings experience. In particular, high solids epoxy, high performance industrial surface coatings, broad wall architectural and construction membranes etc would be highly regarded, as would knowledge of textile and other screen printing ink technologies. They must also be passionate about the environment, have a good eye for colour and for detail as well as an ability to work with minimal supervision. A high degree of numeracy and literacy in English are mandatory, whilst technical fluency in European languages would be highly regarded.  Applicants must have full and permanent working rights in Australia to be considered.

If you feel that you are suited to the role of Quality Control Chemist, then please send your CV to us via email technical@colormaker.com.au.

About Xtremepush

Xtremepush is an Omnichannel Customer Engagement Platform powered by a built-in CDP. It enables leading brands to leverage real-time data, AI and gamification to deliver highly personalised, lifecycle-specific customer journeys that drive conversions at scale. All with one unified solution.
Headquartered in Dublin, and with offices in London, New York, and São Paulo, the company helps operators all around the world understand their customers and improve player experiences world-wide.

Role Purpose 

The Sales and Marketing Manager (APAC) is responsible for planning, directing, and coordinating regional sales and marketing activities to drive revenue growth, customer retention, and brand expansion. The role combines strategic leadership with operational execution, overseeing account management functions, regional go-to-market strategies, and cross-functional collaboration to maximise organisational performance and market presence. 
Key Responsibilities 
1. Sales & Marketing Strategy 
? Direct the development and execution of regional sales strategies, setting targets to maximise revenue, client growth, and customer loyalty. 
? Lead the creation and implementation of marketing and go-to-market strategies to promote the organisation’s products and services across APAC. 
? Drive initiatives to strengthen brand positioning, customer engagement, and long-term brand loyalty in the region. 
? Develop and implement strategies to enhance the organisation’s reputation with clients and stakeholders. 
2. Leadership & Team Management 
? Lead, manage, and grow a team of Account Managers across the APAC region. 
? Provide coaching, mentorship, and performance management to ensure high levels of engagement and productivity. 
? Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance reviews, and development planning. 
? Lead recruitment and onboarding of new team members, including Account Managers and supporting roles. 
? Establish a high-performing regional team aligned with company values and objectives. 
3. Sales Pipeline & Revenue Management 
? Oversee and control the regional sales and account management pipeline to ensure alignment with revenue targets 
? Manage upsell, renewal, and retention strategies to achieve growth and minimise churn. 
? Analyse pipeline performance, identify risks and opportunities, and implement corrective actions. 
? Own forecasting accuracy and provide regular reporting and insights to senior leadership. 
4. Strategic Planning & Regional Expansion 
? Establish and lead the APAC regional function, defining how products and services are sold, managed, and scaled. 
? Contribute to pricing and packaging strategies tailored to regional market conditions. 
? Identify market trends, competitive insights, and customer feedback to inform strategic decisions. 
? Support expansion into new geographies across Asia and Oceania. 
5. Client Relationship & Account Oversight 
? Maintain senior-level relationships with key clients across the region. 
? Ensure high renewal rates, strong customer satisfaction, and delivery of value through account management practices. 
? Act as the primary escalation point for complex client issues across account management, onboarding, and support. 
? Attend strategic conferences and events within the region to promote the business and enforce strong client relations through face to face meetings 
? Oversee delivery quality and resource allocation for new and existing clients. 
6. Systems, Reporting & Process Optimisation 
? Direct the effective use of CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot) to ensure accurate data management, reporting, and automation. 
? Implement best practices for pipeline tracking, forecasting, and customer engagement. 
? Collaborate with finance and operations to align sales forecasts with budgets and strategic plans. 
7. Cross-functional Collaboration 
? Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Support teams to ensure a unified customer approach. 
? Act as the regional liaison to ensure alignment of processes, communication, and execution. 
? Support new business initiatives, including RFP participation and market development activities. 
8. Operational & Support Oversight 
? Oversee service delivery standards, including SLAs, response times, and customer satisfaction metrics. 
? Support interim operational needs (e.g., customer support or onboarding) during regional scaling. 
? Ensure all business functions operate effectively within the APAC region. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 

Revenue & Growth 
? Achievement of upsell and revenue growth targets 
? High renewal rates and minimal customer churn 
Pipeline & Forecasting 
? Accuracy of sales forecasts 
? Maintenance of a healthy and progressing sales pipeline 
Customer Success 
? Strong client satisfaction and retention 
? Delivery of regular business reviews and strategic account engagement 
Team Performance 
? Development and retention of a high-performing team 
? Successful hiring and scaling of regional headcount 
Regional Leadership 
? Successful establishment and growth of APAC operations 
? Effective cross-functional alignment and operational delivery 

Skills & Experience 

? Minimum 3 years of relevant experience and Bachelor degrees in relevant field 
? Proven experience in sales and/or account management leadership roles 
? Strong strategic planning and execution capabilities in sales and marketing 
? Experience managing regional or international markets (APAC preferred) 
? Demonstrated ability to lead teams, drive performance, and scale operations 
? Strong analytical, forecasting, and CRM management skills 
? Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

C Signs Pty Ltd is the premier provider of commercial and industrial signage solutions in Karratha and the broader Pilbara region. We’re committed to delivering superior signage solutions to Pilbara businesses, leveraging cutting-edge technology and our team’s expertise to ensure high-quality project completion.

Since commencing operations in 2024, the company has experienced significant growth; to support this and meet increasing client demand, we are seeking an experienced Graphic Designer to join our team in Karratha, Western Australia, on a full-time basis.

As a Graphic Designer, your everyday responsibilities will include:
• Creating graphic design assets and elements for the company’s brand identity, including logos, letterheads, email signatures, promotional material, social media content and other marketing and communication collateral.
• Creating graphic design layouts and diagrams based on prior consultation with the clients and the analysis of their visual communication requirements.
• Creating brand identities and original artwork for new businesses, including elements like logos, colour palettes and typography, based on the client’s strategy and vision, and its later application across different projects and media.
• Preparing and optimising artwork files for small and large format printing, vinyl cutting, router cutting and other signage production processes.
• Managing client feedback, revisions and approvals throughout the design process.
• Following workflow processes and keeping an organised record of each client’s files to ensure all future work aligns with their brand guidelines across different projects and media.
• Proficient use of Adobe Creative Cloud applications, including Illustrator and Photoshop (essential). Experience with Adobe Lightroom & InDesign is desirable.
• Liaising with clients and suppliers. 

Desirable Skills and Experience - but not mandatory:
• Knowledge and understanding of signage materials, production and installation requirements to assist clients and develop practical and effective visual communication solutions that are suitable for manufacture and application; ie. printed media, illuminated displays, rigid signage, vehicle graphics, marketing and events displays, etc.
• Knowledge of printing software (Roland and HP) and operation of large format printers, vinyl plotters and router cutting machines is highly desirable. 

It is essential to hold a relevant Bachelor’s Degree or higher qualification in Graphic Design, Visual Communication or a related field, or possess a minimum of five years’ relevant industry experience.

This is a full-time position offering a salary package between $85,000 and $105,000 plus superannuation, dependent on qualifications and experience. Position: Supply and Distribution Manager
Type: Full-time
Employer: Melbourne Truss
Location: Somerton VIC
Salary: $90,000 per annum
About the Business:
Melbourne Truss, established in 2005 and based in Somerton, Victoria, is one of the leading manufacturers of prefabricated timber roof trusses, wall frames, floor trusses and posi struts in Melbourne. As a licensed Pryda fabricator, the company utilises the latest design and processing technologies to produce high-quality, certified products tailored to the exact requirements of commercial, residential and owner-builder projects. Trusted by reputable builders across the region, Melbourne Truss also offers transportation services, timber sales and a wide range of lock-up and fixing items. The business prides itself on reliability, efficient material use and a dedicated team committed to delivering superior building frames and exceptional customer service.
About the Position:
The Supply and Distribution Manager plays a pivotal role at Melbourne Truss by overseeing the procurement, storage, inventory management and distribution of materials and finished products in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This position ensures seamless logistics for timber supplies and prefabricated components, coordinating timely deliveries to construction sites while optimising costs and maintaining stock levels. Critical to operational efficiency, the role supports the company's commitment to reliable output and customer satisfaction in the building industry.
Key Responsibilities:
Determine, implement and monitor purchasing, storage and distribution strategies, policies and plans.
Negotiate contracts with suppliers to meet quality, cost and delivery requirements.
Manage inventory systems to maintain optimal stock levels at minimum cost, including tracking movements of raw materials and finished goods.
Oversee transportation and delivery logistics to ensure timely and efficient distribution to customers.
Liaise with production, sales and external stakeholders regarding supply requirements and outbound goods.
Monitor and review storage facilities and inventory controls to comply with safety and operational standards.
Identify opportunities for process improvements to enhance supply chain efficiency and reduce costs.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Bachelor degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in supply and distribution management, preferably in a manufacturing or construction-related industry.
Proven skills in inventory management, procurement negotiation and logistics coordination.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with proficiency in inventory software and Microsoft Office Suite.
Excellent leadership, communication and interpersonal skills to manage teams and collaborate with stakeholders.
Ability to work in a dynamic environment with a focus on safety, efficiency and continuous improvement.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
